# 2 Baruch Chapter 12 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Fall of Jerusalem

---

**12:1** And-the-word-of-the-LORD came-to-me also-a-second time while-I-sat-under-the-oak.

**12:2** And-he-said: "Baruch, why-are-you-sitting-here? And-why-are-you-mourning? And-for-what-cause-do-you-grieve?

**12:3** If-you-are-grieving-on-account-of-Zion, [then] I-will-show-you that-for-which-my-wrath-did-this. Because-of-the-multitude-of-their-transgressions I-delivered-the-city [into-captivity].

**12:4** See-now-with-thine-eyes that-the-enemy-has-not-prevailed-over-Zion, and-has-not-burned-the-temple, until-he-had-leave-from-me. For-the-city-and-the-sanctuary-were-not-taken through-the-strength-of-those-who-attacked [them].

**12:5** Because-a-city cannot-be-taken [by-force] before-I-have-resolved-to-chastise [it]: I-resolve-and-only-then do-men-execute-my-will. And-now I-will-tell-you [the-reason] for-all-these-things."

---

*EMET notes: God explains to Baruch that the destruction was divinely authorized, not a pagan military victory. The enemy had "leave" (permission) from God. This is the theology of contingent divine judgment.*
